adversarial_rule: Adversarial turns (A11-A15) expect NO memory need: injected memories <= 1 per turn (over-injection metric). Bar: at most 1 of 5 turns may exceed (<=20%). Rationale: correct behavior on memory-independent prompts is silence, per VOI-gating.
amendment_log_v1_to_v2: A1 content authored: 18 seed memories + 30 turn scripts + oracles (v1 had bare turn numbers).

A2 patch-parity-90 replaced by tool-fidelity-100 + transcript-validity-gate. Rationale: in a replay rig with scripted ops, model patch quality is unobservable by construction; byte-fidelity of tool calls through the proxy is the correct proxy-measurable (it is exactly what compaction could corrupt).
A3 hallucination reconciled to strict 0.0% table (any unattested injection event fails the arm). The chat text '>5%' is superseded: safety properties do not do percentages.
A4 INCONCLUSIVE band [20,25)% added (was undefined between KILL<20 and TIER2 25-30).

A5 replay-rig made explicit: NO live model; scripted traces; mock upstream with deterministic LCP cache model; tokens chars//4. Live-model effects stay explicitly out of scope (dogfood covers qualitatively).
A6 cache factors per-provider (openai 0.50 / anthropic 0.10); single 0.10 was factually wrong for OpenAI (up to 5x miscomputation). N=5 identical sessions (stability gate, not sampling).
anaphoric_rule: Recall hit on an anaphoric turn = every id in expected_keys is attributed in that turn's capsule (substring match of its attribution key). Bar: >=9 of 10 turns.
attribution_rule: A seed memory counts as injected iff its attribution key appears as a contiguous substring in the received capsule. Harness parses capsule between PINNED tags from the mock-received prompt.

backend.note: Run MUST declare provider; factor applied in accounting; tagged in telemetry.

cache_model_mock.prompt_cached_tokens: LCP(prompt_n, prompt_{n-1}) chars//4 (longest common prefix with previous turn's prompt; deterministic)

workload_b.fidelity_100: byte-equality of every tool call block arriving upstream vs scripted (any mismatch = corruption)
workload_b.integrity_100: validator passes every turn, zero ToolIntegrityError
workload_b.validity_gate: fixture sha + edit-checks green + full-suite signature reproduce (failure VOIDS the run, never KILLs a verdict)

grading.hallucination_event: Any capsule snippet with NO >=20-char contiguous substring match against the KB corpus (18 seed texts + all frozen fixture file bytes). Automated, deterministic. One event fails the arm.
grading.recall_hit: expected_keys ⊆ attributed ids (per-turn, workload A anaphoric only).

hallucination_corpus: 18 seed memory full texts + every byte of the frozen fixture (sha d729a9905fbaa4772df029a2b8d5df7169a9776401e5e2ef6ed6dcb54619536b, pycache excluded). Daemon truncates, never paraphrases, so every legitimate snippet matches by construction.

mock_upstream.behavior: Canned ACK (~30 tokens). Reports usage per cache_model_mock. TTFT measured as first-chunk latency minus direct-mock baseline.
mock_upstream.purpose: Deterministic transport so the SYSTEM under test is proxy+memory, never model mood.

no_live_model: Explicit: no frontier API calls in v2 rig. All assistant texts and tool calls are locked scripts. Variance across the 5 identical runs is expected ~0 (deterministic rig); the 5 runs are a stability gate (every run individually free of ToolIntegrityError/hallucination), not a sample.

rig.harness_drives: Real proxy_server process + real daemon (seed DB from seed_memories below) + mock upstream over HTTP. Harness observes prompts at the mock (exact bytes the model would see).
rig.transport: HTTP against proxy with mock upstream; direct-mock baseline arm in parallel.

Validity gate failure is NOT a KILL (it voids the run: fix rig/fixture, rerun).
verdict_mapping.TIER_1_UNQUALIFIED_PASS: Both arms exceed ALL gates incl. system caps: proxy saves >50%/>30% real dollars without breaking a single tool.
verdict_mapping.TIER_2_QUALIFIED_PRODUCT_PASS: Workload A fully passes (>=50% savings, zero hallucination) AND Workload B keeps 100% integrity+fidelity with moderate 25-30% savings AND system caps hold.
